class.corsair_battleship.blurb: Slow and powerful. Three modules a slot — one yours, two the crew's — behind four quarter shields. Being circled costs it far more than it costs the cruiser.
class.corsair_battleship.name: Battleship
class.corsair_cruiser.blurb: Two modules a slot, behind a fore and an aft shield bank. Turn to present the good side.
class.corsair_cruiser.name: Cruiser
class.corsair_frigate.blurb: Fast and light. One module a slot, a deep battery, and a single shield dome — facing stops mattering, and being hit at all is the only question left.
class.corsair_frigate.name: Frigate
